description: The photo viewer's view after a pan by dx/dy, held where the picture can be: an edge never pulled in past the stage's, and a side narrower than the stage centered. Views are { scale, x, y }: scale 1 at (0, 0) is the picture fitted to the stage and centered, x/y move its center in pixels from the stage's center. Sizes are { width, height }.

cases.name: panning stops at the picture's edges, and a side narrower than the stage stays centered
a pan within the edges moves the picture
a fitted picture does not move
